quiet behaviours that make you
look 10x more attractive
part 2

1. holding eye contact
while you listen

not while you talk.
while you listen.

2. remembering small details

her dog's name, his exam.
people never forget it.

3. never interrupting

even when you're excited
about what you'll say.

4. speaking well of people
who aren't in the room

5. staying calm in a queue

patience is the most
underrated kind of elegance.

6. always having something
interesting to share

a painting, a story,
a fact from history.
